en.product-name.blocks.0.text: ModelNex.AI is the globally unified name of the product and does not have a Chinese name, abbreviation or other regional name. Product names, client brands and service brands remain consistent in different countries and regions.
en.product-overview.intro: ModelNex.AI is a comprehensive VPN service for individual users, individual developers and technical users, taking into account the needs of advanced users and enterprise-level customization.
en.product-overview.blocks.0.text: ModelNex.AI not only provides basic VPN connection capabilities, but also provides professional functions for network engineering, development, privacy protection, and advanced network configuration scenarios, including multi-platform clients, network routing and offloading, DNS configuration, IPv4/IPv6 related functions, node management, connection control, and other advanced network functions.
en.product-overview.blocks.1.text: The overall product is designed with lightweight, professional and low-interference as its main design directions, without advertising interfering with normal use, and providing relatively complete network configuration capabilities for technical users.
en.product-overview.blocks.2.text: ModelNex.AI also offers AI-assisted services. Users can obtain product usage help and auxiliary answers to some professional network technical questions through AI services, thereby lowering the threshold for using advanced network functions.
en.product-positioning.intro: The core positioning of ModelNex.AI is a professional comprehensive VPN service.
en.product-positioning.blocks.0.text: The product also covers the following usage scenarios:
en.product-positioning.blocks.1.items.1: Network environment for individual developers and technical staff;
en.product-positioning.blocks.1.items.8: Collaborative use of multiple devices and platforms;
en.product-positioning.blocks.1.items.9: Network testing and debugging by technicians;
en.product-positioning.blocks.1.items.10: Custom node and protocol usage for advanced users;
en.product-positioning.blocks.1.items.11: Customized needs of enterprises and special scenarios.
en.product-positioning.blocks.2.text: ModelNex.AI doesn't position itself as just a basic "click-to-connect" VPN tool, but instead offers multi-layered networking capabilities for both casual and technical users.
en.product-positioning.blocks.3.text: For enterprise users, the enterprise-level functions and specialized support currently provided by ModelNex.AI are still limited, so an independent enterprise service entrance will not be set up for the time being. Businesses or organizations with special needs can contact us individually through official channels to evaluate the feasibility of customized services.
en.product-service-regions.intro: ModelNex.AI’s current official service scope is fixed at 30 countries:
en.product-service-regions.blocks.1.text: In addition to the above 30 countries, ModelNex.AI currently does not include other countries or regions in its official service scope.
en.product-service-regions.blocks.2.text: The specific country list of service areas, country-level service descriptions, network policies, and specific differences between different regions are subject to the official information in the "Service Areas and Nodes" chapter.
en.product-service-regions.blocks.3.text: Service areas may be adjusted based on product operations, infrastructure, laws and regulations, and service capabilities. Any changes in service areas are subject to official information.
en.product-clients-platforms.intro: ModelNex.AI currently provides the following seven types of clients:
en.product-clients-platforms.blocks.1.text: Among them, the Linux client and the CLI client belong to two independent product forms.
en.product-clients-platforms.blocks.2.text: The Linux client is designed for a complete Linux usage environment, while the CLI client is positioned as a cross-platform pure command line client. The CLI does not target Linux only, but can be used on servers, Raspberry Pis, ARM devices, and other devices with compatible operating environments.
en.product-clients-platforms.blocks.3.text: Different platforms may have different functions, system permissions, network capabilities and configuration methods. Some advanced features may vary based on operating system limitations, system APIs, device capabilities, or platform policies.
en.product-clients-platforms.blocks.4.text: For the specific installation methods, function support and differences of each platform, please refer to the corresponding platform documents in the "Client" chapter.
en.product-network-capabilities.intro: ModelNex.AI provides complete VPN network connectivity and a variety of network control features for advanced users.
en.product-network-capabilities.blocks.0.te: Main abilities include but are not limited to:
en.product-network-capabilities.blocks.2.te: The specific functions provided by different clients are not exactly the same.
en.product-network-capabilities.blocks.3.te: ModelNex.AI will provide corresponding function implementation based on the network models, system permissions and platform capabilities of different operating systems. Therefore, the setting interface and available options of Windows, Android, Linux, CLI, iPhone, iPad and macOS may be different.
en.product-protocols-technology.intro: ModelNex.AI uses Dolphin-Core as the core VPN network engine.
en.product-protocols-technology.blocks.0.te: Dolphin-Core is deeply modified based on the Sing-Box project, and has made a large number of modifications and expansions based on its own product needs during the long-term development process of ModelNex.AI. Therefore, Dolphin-Core should not be understood simply as the original, unmodified Sing-Box client.
en.product-protocols-technology.blocks.1.te: ModelNex.AI currently supports the following VPN/network protocols:
en.product-protocols-technology.blocks.2.it: ModelNex.AI supported by Dolphin-Core has its own implementation;
en.product-protocols-technology.blocks.3.te: ModelNex.AI currently makes no commitment to support protocols other than those listed above.
en.product-protocols-technology.blocks.4.te: For specific protocol implementation, version, compatibility and public technical information, please refer to the "Open Source and Technology" chapter.
en.product-custom-nodes-protocols.intro: ModelNex.AI provides basic software usage capabilities.
Users can still use the basic functions of the client without purchasing the ModelNex.AI premium service, and can import their own node and protocol configurations based on client support.
The nodes, servers and related network resources provided by the users themselves are not the service resources of ModelNex.AI, and the users are solely responsible for their availability, performance, security and legality.
ModelNex.AI clients will provide compatibility with supported protocols and configuration formats as much as possible, but the actual support range of different platforms may vary.
en.product-advanced-services.blocks.0.text: Advanced services and basic software usage capabilities are not exactly the same. Some professional network capabilities, service resources, node resources or other advanced functions may require corresponding subscriptions or service permissions.
en.product-advanced-services.blocks.1.text: Specific service content, packages, prices, permissions and restrictions are subject to the current information published in the "Subscription, Ordering and Payment" section.
en.product-node-services.intro: ModelNex.AI currently offers official node services on a limited scale.
en.product-node-services.blocks.0.text: The official nodes at this stage include:
en.product-node-services.blocks.2.text: The number of official nodes will be gradually expanded based on infrastructure construction, service needs and operating conditions.
en.product-node-services.blocks.3.text: Node type, node status, node region, node availability, and specific service capabilities may change. Official nodes do not represent exactly the same connection performance on all platforms, all protocols, or all network environments.
en.product-node-services.blocks.4.text: For specific information about nodes, please refer to the real-time information in the "Service Areas and Nodes" chapter.
en.product-ai-support.intro: ModelNex.AI provides AI-assisted services to help users understand and use product functions, and assist in handling some network technology-related issues.
en.product-ai-support.blocks.0.text: AI-assisted services can be used for:
en.product-ai-support.blocks.1.items.4: Analysis of issues related to routing and distribution;
en.product-ai-support.blocks.2.text: The content provided by AI is auxiliary information. For operations involving network security, system configuration, data security or other operations that may have actual impact, users should confirm based on the actual environment before execution.
en.product-ai-support.blocks.3.text: AI services are not a substitute for professional legal, medical, financial or other services that require professional qualifications by law.
en.product-customer-service.intro: ModelNex.AI provides professional customer service support.
en.product-customer-service.blocks.0.text: Customer service is mainly used to handle product usage, accounts, subscriptions, network connections and other product-related issues.
en.product-customer-service.blocks.1.text: For complex network engineering problems, ModelNex.AI will provide corresponding technical assistance capabilities based on the type of problem.
en.product-customer-service.blocks.2.text: Enterprise users currently do not enjoy an independent enterprise service system. If an enterprise or organization requires special network architecture, customized functions or other professional services, it can contact ModelNex.AI through official channels, and both parties will independently evaluate the specific needs.
en.product-privacy-logs.intro: ModelNex.AI does not use "zero logs" as a product promotion or service promise.
en.product-privacy-logs.blocks.0.text: During normal operation, the VPN service needs to generate certain service operation logs, system logs, error logs, security logs and other technical records necessary to provide, maintain, protect and improve services.
en.product-privacy-logs.blocks.1.text: At the same time, ModelNex.AI provides a log permission control mechanism, allowing users to control some enhanced log collection scope related to personal usage behavior according to their own needs.
en.product-privacy-logs.blocks.2.text: If the user does not actively enable the corresponding advanced log permission, ModelNex.AI will not proactively expand the enhanced log collection within the user's control based on enabling this permission.
en.product-privacy-logs.blocks.3.text: Users can manage the optional log range based on the log permission settings actually provided by the client.
en.product-privacy-logs.blocks.4.text: After the user actively enables more advanced log permissions, the system may collect more technical information related to connections and network usage, such as IP addresses, domain names, connection timestamps, and other information for failure analysis, service improvement, and network quality optimization.
en.product-privacy-logs.blocks.5.text: The specific collection scope, processing purpose, storage period, access rights and deletion mechanism of different types of logs are subject to the official instructions in the "Security and Privacy" and "Formal Legal Documents" chapters.
en.product-privacy-logs.blocks.6.text: It should be noted that "turning off user-optional log permissions" does not mean that all server, system, security, and operational logs of ModelNex.AI have stopped recording.
en.product-advertising-experience.intro: ModelNex.AI is designed with an ad-free, low-interference product experience.
The client and core usage processes will not use display advertising as the main product model.
Specific third-party services, analysis tools, statistical mechanisms and related data processing methods are subject to the official descriptions in the Privacy Policy and Cookie Policy.
en.product-open-source.intro: ModelNex.AI is committed to exposing some clients and technical implementations.
en.product-open-source.blocks.0.text: The overall code for Windows, Linux and Android clients is currently planned to be available as an open source project.
en.product-open-source.blocks.1.text: The server-side code will be gradually evaluated as part of the open source code based on the actual situation, but the complete open source scope of the server side has not yet been finalized.
en.product-open-source.blocks.2.text: The specific repositories, licenses, code scope, third-party dependencies and open source obligations of open source projects are subject to the official information in the "Open Source and Technology" chapter and the corresponding open source repositories.
en.product-open-source.blocks.3.text: ModelNex.AI does not promise to disclose all server code, internal infrastructure or internal operating systems.
en.product-internal-technology.intro: In order to ensure service security, stability and operational capabilities, ModelNex.AI does not disclose some internal technical information.
en.product-internal-technology.blocks.1.ite: Other internal information that may affect the security of the service.
en.product-internal-technology.blocks.2.tex: Public technical documents only describe technical architecture, protocols, interfaces, open source projects and related implementation information suitable for disclosure.
en.product-design-principles.intro: The product design of ModelNex.AI mainly follows the following principles:
en.product-design-principles.blocks.0.text: Lightweight. Reduce client resource usage and usage complexity as much as possible, and maintain a lightweight running experience while meeting functional requirements.
en.product-design-principles.blocks.1.text: specialization. Provides network configuration and control capabilities for developers, network engineers, and advanced users.
en.product-design-principles.blocks.2.text: Low interference. Reduce advertisements and unnecessary product interference, and focus on core network functions.
en.product-design-principles.blocks.3.text: Multi-platform. Provides multi-platform support through Windows, Android, Linux, CLI, iPhone, iPad, and macOS, with corresponding implementations based on each platform's capabilities.
en.product-design-principles.blocks.4.text: Openness. It exposes some clients and technical implementations, and supports users to import their own node and protocol configurations.
en.product-design-principles.blocks.5.text: Security. Ensure the security of service operation through protocols, encryption, network isolation, permission control, log permissions and other security mechanisms.
en.product-design-principles.blocks.6.text: Maintainability. Maintain long-term maintainability of products through version management, protocol management, API version control and document change recording.
en.product-service-boundaries.intro: ModelNex.AI is a VPN software and network service provider and does not promise to provide control, guarantee or guarantee for all Internet content, third-party services or third-party network resources that users access.
en.product-service-boundaries.blocks.0.text: Users are still required to abide by the applicable laws and regulations, third-party service terms and other binding rules of their location and the location of the services they access.
en.product-service-boundaries.blocks.1.text: ModelNex.AI does not alter the user's responsibility for their own online behavior because of the provision of VPN technology.
en.product-service-boundaries.blocks.2.text: Specific user responsibilities, prohibited behaviors, service restrictions and service termination conditions are subject to the "Terms of Service" and "Acceptable Use Policy".
en.product-information-priority.intro: This page is used to introduce the product positioning, main capabilities and basic service scope of ModelNex.AI.
en.product-information-priority.blocks.0.te: For specific functions, prices, node status, platform support, protocol compatibility, data processing methods, user rights and legal obligations, the latest versions in the corresponding official pages and legal documents shall prevail.
en.product-information-priority.blocks.1.te: When there are differences between product introductions and specific technical documents, terms of service, privacy policies or other official documents, the latest official documents on the corresponding matters shall prevail.

zh-TW.product-name.blocks.0.text: ModelNex.AI 為產品全球統一名稱，不設中文名稱、簡稱或其他地區名稱。產品名稱、客戶端品牌及服務品牌在不同國家和地區保持統一。
zh-TW.product-overview.intro: ModelNex.AI 是一款針對個人用戶、個人開發者及技術用戶，同時兼顧高階用戶和企業級客製化需求的綜合型 VPN 服務。
zh-TW.product-overview.blocks.0.text: ModelNex.AI 不僅提供基礎的 VPN 連線能力，還提供網路工程、開發、隱私保護和進階網路設定場景的專業功能，包括多平台用戶端、網路路由與分流、DNS 設定、IPv4/IPv6 相關功能、節點管理、連線控制以及其他進階網路功能。
zh-TW.product-overview.blocks.1.text: 產品整體以輕量化、專業化和低幹擾為主要設計方向，不透過廣告幹擾正常使用，並針對技術使用者提供較完整的網路配置能力。
zh-TW.product-overview.blocks.2.text: ModelNex.AI 同時提供 AI 輔助服務。使用者可透過 AI 服務取得產品使用協助以及部分專業網路技術問題的輔助解答，從而降低進階網路功能的使用門檻。
zh-TW.product-positioning.intro: ModelNex.AI 的核心定位為專業型綜合 VPN 服務。
zh-TW.product-positioning.blocks.0.text: 產品同時覆蓋以下使用場景：
zh-TW.product-positioning.blocks.1.items.1: 個人開發者及技術人員的網路環境；
zh-TW.product-positioning.blocks.1.items.7: 進階 VPN 參數配置；
zh-TW.product-positioning.blocks.1.items.8: 多設備、多平台協同使用；
zh-TW.product-positioning.blocks.1.items.9: 技術人員的網路測試與調試；
zh-TW.product-positioning.blocks.1.items.10: 高階用戶的自訂節點與協定使用；
zh-TW.product-positioning.blocks.1.items.11: 企業及特殊場景的客製化需求。
zh-TW.product-positioning.blocks.2.text: ModelNex.AI 並未將自身定位為僅提供「點擊連線即可使用」的基礎 VPN 工具，而是同時提供針對一般使用者和技術使用者的多層次網路能力。
zh-TW.product-positioning.blocks.3.text: 對於企業用戶，ModelNex.AI 目前提供的企業級功能和專門化支援仍處於有限狀態，因此暫不設置獨立的企業服務入口。有特殊需求的企業或組織可以透過官方管道單獨聯繫，以評估客製化服務的可行性。
zh-TW.product-service-regions.intro: ModelNex.AI 目前正式服務範圍固定為 30 個國家：
zh-TW.product-service-regions.blocks.1.text: 除上述 30 個國家外，ModelNex.AI 目前不將其他國家或地區列入正式服務範圍。
zh-TW.product-service-regions.blocks.2.text: 服務區域的具體國家清單、國家級服務說明、網路策略以及不同地區之間的具體差異，以「服務區域與節點」章節中的正式資訊為準。
zh-TW.product-service-regions.blocks.3.text: 服務區域可能根據產品運作、基礎設施、法規及服務能力而調整。任何服務區域變更均以官方公佈的資訊為準。
zh-TW.product-clients-platforms.intro: ModelNex.AI 目前提供以下七類用戶端：
zh-TW.product-clients-platforms.blocks.1.text: 其中，Linux 用戶端與 CLI 用戶端屬於兩個獨立的產品形態。
zh-TW.product-clients-platforms.blocks.2.text: Linux 用戶端面向完整 Linux 使用環境，CLI 用戶端則定位為跨平台純命令列用戶端。 CLI 不以 Linux 為唯一目標平台，可用於伺服器、樹莓派、ARM 裝置以及其他具備相容運作環境的裝置。
zh-TW.product-clients-platforms.blocks.3.text: 不同平台的功能、系統權限、網路能力及配置方式可能有差異。部分進階功能可能會根據作業系統限制、系統 API、裝置能力或平台政策而有所不同。
zh-TW.product-clients-platforms.blocks.4.text: 各平台的具體安裝方式、功能支援情況及差異，以「客戶端」章節中的對應平台文件為準。
zh-TW.product-network-capabilities.intro: ModelNex.AI 提供完整的 VPN 網路連線能力，並針對進階使用者提供多種網路控制功能。
zh-TW.product-network-capabilities.blocks.0.te: 主要能力包括但不限於：
zh-TW.product-network-capabilities.blocks.1.it: DNS 洩漏相關防護能力；
IPv6 洩漏相關防護能力；
zh-TW.product-network-capabilities.blocks.2.te: 不同客戶端提供的具體功能並不完全相同。
zh-TW.product-network-capabilities.blocks.3.te: ModelNex.AI 會根據不同作業系統的網路模型、系統權限及平台能力提供對應的功能實現，因此 Windows、Android、Linux、CLI、iPhone、iPad 和 macOS 的設定介面及可用選項可能存在差異。
zh-TW.product-protocols-technology.intro: ModelNex.AI 使用 Dolphin-Core 作為核心 VPN 網路引擎。
zh-TW.product-protocols-technology.blocks.0.te: Dolphin-Core 基於 Sing-Box 專案進行深度改造，並在 ModelNex.AI 的長期開發過程中進行了大量針對自身產品需求的修改和擴展。因此，Dolphin-Core 不應簡單理解為未經修改的原始 Sing-Box 用戶端。
zh-TW.product-protocols-technology.blocks.1.te: ModelNex.AI 目前支援以下 VPN / 網路協定：
zh-TW.product-protocols-technology.blocks.2.it: Dolphin-Core 支援的 ModelNex.AI 自有實現；
zh-TW.product-protocols-technology.blocks.3.te: ModelNex.AI 目前不承諾支援上述清單以外的其他協定。
zh-TW.product-protocols-technology.blocks.4.te: 具體協議實現、版本、相容性及公開技術資料，以「開源與技術」章節為準。
zh-TW.product-custom-nodes-protocols.intro: ModelNex.AI 提供基礎軟體使用能力。
使用者在不購買 ModelNex.AI 進階服務的情況下，也可以使用客戶端的基礎功能，並且可以根據客戶端支援情況匯入自己的節點及協定配置。
使用者自行提供的節點、伺服器及相關網路資源不屬於 ModelNex.AI 的服務資源，其可用性、效能、安全性和合法性由使用者自行負責。
ModelNex.AI 的用戶端將盡可能提供對已支援協定和配置格式的相容能力，但不同平台的實際支援範圍可能存在差異。
zh-TW.product-advanced-services.intro: ModelNex.AI 同時提供進階服務。
zh-TW.product-advanced-services.blocks.0.text: 進階服務與基礎軟體使用能力並非完全相同。部分專業網路能力、服務資源、節點資源或其他進階功能可能需要對應的訂閱或服務權限。
zh-TW.product-advanced-services.blocks.1.text: 具體服務內容、套餐、價格、權限及限制，以「訂閱、訂單與支付」章節所公佈的當前資訊為準。
zh-TW.product-node-services.intro: ModelNex.AI 目前提供有限規模的官方節點服務。
zh-TW.product-node-services.blocks.2.text: 官方節點數量將根據基礎建設、服務需求及營運情況逐步擴展。
zh-TW.product-node-services.blocks.3.text: 節點類型、節點狀態、節點地區、節點可用性以及特定服務能力可能會變更。官方節點並不代表所有平台、所有協定或所有網路環境下均具有完全相同的連線表現。
zh-TW.product-node-services.blocks.4.text: 關於節點的具體訊息，以「服務區域與節點」章節的即時資訊為準。
zh-TW.product-ai-support.intro: ModelNex.AI 提供 AI 輔助服務，用於幫助使用者理解和使用產品功能，並輔助處理部分網路技術相關問題。
zh-TW.product-ai-support.blocks.1.items.4: 路由與分流相關問題分析；
zh-TW.product-ai-support.blocks.1.items.6: 基礎網路技術問題解答；
zh-TW.product-ai-support.blocks.2.text: AI 提供的內容屬於輔助性資訊。對於涉及網路安全、系統配置、資料安全或其他可能產生實際影響的操作，使用者應在執行前根據實際環境進行確認。
zh-TW.product-ai-support.blocks.3.text: AI 服務不能取代專業法律、醫療、財務或其他依法需要專業資格的服務。
zh-TW.product-customer-service.intro: ModelNex.AI 提供專業客服支援。
zh-TW.product-customer-service.blocks.0.text: 客服主要用於產品使用、帳戶、訂閱、網路連線以及其他產品相關問題的處理。
zh-TW.product-customer-service.blocks.1.text: 對於複雜的網路工程問題，ModelNex.AI 將根據問題類型提供相應的技術輔助能力。
zh-TW.product-customer-service.blocks.2.text: 企業用戶目前不享有獨立的企業服務體系。如果企業或組織需要特殊網路架構、客製化功能或其他專業服務，可以透過官方管道聯繫 ModelNex.AI，由雙方單獨評估特定需求。
zh-TW.product-privacy-logs.intro: ModelNex.AI 不以「零日誌」作為產品宣傳或服務承諾。
zh-TW.product-privacy-logs.blocks.0.text: VPN 服務在正常運作過程中需要產生一定的服務運作日誌、系統日誌、錯誤日誌、安全性日誌及其他為提供、維護、保護和改進服務所需的技術記錄。
zh-TW.product-privacy-logs.blocks.1.text: 同時，ModelNex.AI 提供日誌權限控制機制，使用戶能夠根據自身需求控制部分與個人使用行為相關的增強日誌收集範圍。
zh-TW.product-privacy-logs.blocks.2.text: 在使用者未主動啟用對應進階日誌權限的情況下，ModelNex.AI 不會以啟用該權限為前提，主動擴大使用者可控制範圍內的增強日誌收集。
zh-TW.product-privacy-logs.blocks.3.text: 使用者可以根據客戶端實際提供的日誌權限設置，對可選日誌範圍進行管理。
zh-TW.product-privacy-logs.blocks.4.text: 在使用者主動啟用更高級的日誌權限後，系統可能會收集更多與連接和網路使用相關的技術信息，例如 IP 位址、網域名稱、連接時間戳以及其他用於故障分析、服務改進和網路品質優化的資訊。
zh-TW.product-privacy-logs.blocks.5.text: 不同類型日誌的具體收集範圍、處理目的、保存期限、存取權限及刪除機制，以「安全與隱私」及「正式法律文件」章節中的正式說明為準。
zh-TW.product-privacy-logs.blocks.6.text: 需要特別說明的是，「關閉使用者選用日誌權限」並不等於 ModelNex.AI 的全部伺服器、系統、安全性及運作日誌均停止記錄。
zh-TW.product-advertising-experience.intro: ModelNex.AI 以無廣告、低幹擾的產品體驗為設計方向。
用戶端及核心使用流程不會以展示廣告作為主要產品模式。
具體第三方服務、分析工具、統計機制以及相關資料處理方式，以隱私權政策和 Cookie 政策中的正式說明為準。
zh-TW.product-open-source.intro: ModelNex.AI 致力於公開部分用戶端及技術實作。
zh-TW.product-open-source.blocks.0.text: 目前 Windows、Linux 和 Android 用戶端的整體程式碼計畫是作為開源專案提供。
zh-TW.product-open-source.blocks.1.text: 服務端程式碼將根據實際情況逐步評估部分開源，但服務端完整開源範圍目前尚未最終確定。
zh-TW.product-open-source.blocks.2.text: 開源專案的特定倉庫、許可證、程式碼範圍、第三方依賴及開源義務，以「開源與技術」章節及相應開源倉庫中的正式資訊為準。
zh-TW.product-open-source.blocks.3.text: ModelNex.AI 不承諾公開全部服務端程式碼、內部基礎架構或內部營運系統。
zh-TW.product-internal-technology.intro: 為了確保服務安全、穩定性和營運能力，ModelNex.AI 不公開部分內部技術資訊。
zh-TW.product-internal-technology.blocks.1.ite: 其他可能影響服務安全性的內部資訊。
zh-TW.product-internal-technology.blocks.2.tex: 公開技術文件僅描述適合公開的技術架構、協定、介面、開源專案及相關實作資訊。
zh-TW.product-design-principles.intro: ModelNex.AI 的產品設計主要遵循以下原則：
zh-TW.product-design-principles.blocks.0.text: 輕量化。盡可能降低客戶端資源佔用和使用複雜度，在滿足功能需求的同時保持較輕的運作體驗。
zh-TW.product-design-principles.blocks.1.text: 專業化。提供開發者、網路工程師及進階使用者的網路配置與控制能力。
zh-TW.product-design-principles.blocks.2.text: 低幹擾。減少廣告及不必要的產品幹擾，將核心網路功能作為產品重點。
zh-TW.product-design-principles.blocks.3.text: 多平台。透過 Windows、Android、Linux、CLI、iPhone、iPad 和 macOS 提供多平台支持，並根據各平台能力提供相應的實現。
zh-TW.product-design-principles.blocks.4.text: 開放性。公開部分客戶端及技術實現，同時支援用戶導入自身節點及協定配置。
zh-TW.product-design-principles.blocks.5.text: 安全性。透過協定、加密、網路隔離、權限控制、日誌權限及其他安全機制保障服務運作安全。
zh-TW.product-design-principles.blocks.6.text: 可維護性。透過版本管理、協議管理、API 版本控制及文件變更記錄維持產品長期可維護性。
zh-TW.product-service-boundaries.intro: ModelNex.AI 是 VPN 軟體及網路服務供應商，不承諾對使用者存取的所有網路內容、第三方服務或第三方網路資源提供控制、保證或擔保。
zh-TW.product-service-boundaries.blocks.0.text: 使用者仍需遵守其所在地以及所訪問服務所在地適用的法律法規、第三方服務條款及其他具有約束力的規則。
zh-TW.product-service-boundaries.blocks.1.text: ModelNex.AI 不會因為提供 VPN 技術而改變使用者對其自身網路行為所承擔的責任。
zh-TW.product-service-boundaries.blocks.2.text: 具體使用者責任、禁止行為、服務限制及服務終止條件，以《服務條款》及《可接受使用政策》為準。
zh-TW.product-information-priority.intro: 本頁面用於介紹 ModelNex.AI 的產品定位、主要能力和基本服務範圍。
zh-TW.product-information-priority.blocks.0.te: 具體功能、價格、節點狀態、平台支援、協定相容性、資料處理方式、使用者權利及法律義務，應以對應正式頁面和法律文件中的最新版本為準。
zh-TW.product-information-priority.blocks.1.te: 當產品介紹與具體技術文件、服務條款、隱私權政策或其他正式文件有差異時，應以對應事項的最新正式文件為準。
